title: Historic center
content: Rome's historic center contains major ancient Roman, Renaissance and Baroque landmarks, including the Colosseum, Roman Forum and Pantheon.

title: Villa Borghese
content: A large central park suitable for walking, cycling and combining outdoor activity with nearby museums.

title: Historic London
content: London combines Roman origins, medieval institutions and modern cultural districts. Major historic areas include Westminster and the City of London.

title: Shopping areas
content: Oxford Street, Regent Street and Covent Garden are major central shopping areas; markets include Borough Market and Camden Market.

title: Seafront
content: Tel Aviv has a long Mediterranean promenade and beaches, popular for walking, running, cycling and sunset viewing.

title: Markets and dining
content: Carmel Market and surrounding neighborhoods offer casual food, restaurants and nightlife.

title: Danube and Castle District
content: Budapest's Danube riverfront, Buda Castle district and bridges are major sightseeing areas with extensive walking routes.

title: Thermal baths
content: Budapest is known for historic thermal baths such as Széchenyi and Gellért.

title: Historic hills
content: Lisbon's Alfama, Baixa and Belém districts combine historic architecture, viewpoints and riverside walks.

title: Local dining
content: Lisbon is known for seafood, traditional Portuguese cooking and pastry shops, particularly around central districts and Belém.
